I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed fora public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of thatAct. Details of the purpose and land is described in table II.
1. Description of the purpose:– For the construction of AccessRoad to the Dippitiya reservoir of Kandy North and Pathadumbaraintegrated Water supply project.

2. Description of the land:– An allotment of depicted in theAdvance Tracing No. Maha/AKR/2016/418 dated 17.04.2017prepared by the Surveyor-General situated in the Village ofDippitiya, Village at Udagampaha Minor Division in the DivisionalSecretary’s Division of Akurana in Kandy District of Central Provinceand bounded as follows:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Extent: About 0.0093 HectareNorth: Road, Saistan Seed Division Estate claimed by S. M. S.Noorul Asmiya and Lot B; East: Lot B; South: Dippitiya-Arambepola
Road (Pradeshiya Sabhawa) and Saistan Seed Division Estate claimedby U. G. N. Heenbanda; West: Saistan Seed Division Estate claimedby U. G. N. Heenbanda.

02. Lot ‘B’ – Saistan Seed Division Estate – Extent: About0.0053 HectareNorth: Saistan Seed Division Estate claimed by S. M. S. NoorulAsmiya and the balance portion of the same land claimed by M. G.Athula Priyadarshana Bandara; East: The balance portion of thesame land claimed by M. G. Athula Priyadarshana Bandara; South:Dippitiya-Arambepola Road (Pradeshiya Sabhawa) and Lot A; West:Lot A.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
